architecture.three_valid_operations: represented directly by a three-bit-set mask; exactly three payload SRAMs are enabled
architecture.lane_assignment: physical lane=(phase+payload_rank) mod 4; phase advances by valid payload count
architecture.stall_rule: advance only on a ready/valid acceptance event; a stall holds config PC, phase, all lane pointers, pipeline valid/mask/phase, SRAM enables, and output registers together
architecture.program_entry: reset phase to zero and load four lane base/limit descriptors
architecture.control_flow_scope: linear traces; branches or loops require checkpointing config PC, phase, and four payload positions
